name: Geometría de Nariz
description: Analiza la geometría de la nariz para detectar inconsistencias de deepfake
algorithm: Nose Geometry — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes nose geometry for deepfake detection:

1. **Nose Landmark Seguimiento**: Detailed nose landmarks — bridge, tip, alae (wings), nostrils, columella, nasion (bridge root) — are tracked per frame. These landmarks define the nose's 3D geometry projected into 2D.

2. **Geométrico Proportion Análisis**: Nose proportions should follow anatomical constraints: bridge width vs. alar width, nostril size relative to nose length, tip protrusion relative to bridge height. The method checks whether proportions remain within normal human ranges and are consistent across frames. Deepfakes may produce floating proportions.

3. **3D Shape Consistencia**: The nose is a prominent 3D structure that should show consistent self-occlusion and shading as head pose changes. The method verifies that nose appearance changes (nostril visibility, bridge shadow, tip highlight) are geometrically consistent with the estimated head pose. AI generators may produce incorrect nose shading at certain poses.

4. **Nose - Rostro Integración**: The nose must integrate seamlessly with surrounding facial features — nasolabial folds connect nose to cheeks, bridge connects to brow ridge, and skin texture continues smoothly. The method checks for boundary artifacts around the nose perimeter. Face-swap blending may be visible at nose boundaries.

5. **Temporal Shape Estabilidad**: Nose cartilage provides a rigid structure — nose geometry shouldn't change between frames (only viewing angle changes). The method tracks nose proportions over time. Frame-to-frame variation in nose proportions indicates AI generation where the nose is independently rendered each frame.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante nose geometry analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
